description: RMS Live Traffic Map - Developer Options is a dataset listed in NSW Government open data portal (data.nsw.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Roads and Maritime Services. Locations of current hazards and major events, including incidents, scheduled road work, major events, fire, flood, and alpine conditions. Also static locations such as heavy vehicle checking stations, Safe-T-Cams and rest areas. Coverage: New South Wales. The portal files it under the publisher Roads and Maritime Services. Its tags are live traffic, road transport. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2016-07-20 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-nsw.
